questions.q: What caused the accident that hurt Captain?
choices: A drunk drayman lost control of his horses and crashed into the cab
Captain slipped on ice
A train frightened Captain
Jerry fell asleep while driving
questions.evidence: the man had no control over them

questions.q: How was Captain hurt in the crash?
choices: A splintered shaft ran into his side
He broke a leg
He lost an eye
He was burned
questions.evidence: the shafts splintered, and one of them ran into his side

questions.q: What happened to the drayman after the accident?
choices: He was proved to be drunk and was fined
He went to prison for life
He was never found
He paid Jerry a hundred pounds
questions.evidence: The drayman was proved to be very drunk, and was fined

questions.q: Why did Jerry say talk of "compensation" was nonsense?
choices: Money could not make up for losing a good horse that was like an old friend
He did not need any money
The brewer refused to pay
He thought the accident was his own fault
questions.evidence: losing a good horse that's like an old friend

questions.q: How long had Jerry gone without tasting a drop of drink?
choices: Ten years
Two days
Several weeks
One year
questions.evidence: now for ten years I have not tasted a drop

questions.q: What helped Jerry when the craving for drink came on?
choices: A cup of coffee, some peppermint, or reading his book
Going to the tavern for one small glass
Driving faster
Sleeping in the stable
questions.evidence: I used to get a cup of coffee, or some peppermint, or read a bit in my book

questions.q: Why would Jerry not sell old Captain for a few pounds?
choices: He would not sell a good old servant into hard work and misery
No one wanted to buy him
Captain was worth much more
The governor told him not to
questions.evidence: a few pounds got by selling a good old servant into hard work and misery would canker all the rest of his money

questions.q: What did Black Beauty find when he came back from getting new shoes?
choices: Captain was gone
Captain was well again
A new cab was waiting
Jerry had sold the stable
questions.evidence: when I returned Captain was gone

questions.q: Why did the under-groom think Hotspur had run away?
choices: Tight harness, a check-rein, and a sharp curb hurt his tender mouth
He was a vicious horse
He was frightened by a dog
He was very old and confused
questions.evidence: It is my belief that it made the horse mad, being tender in the mouth and so full of spirit

questions.q: Jerry said "it was an ill wind that blew nobody good." What does that saying mean here?
choices: Something bad for one person turned out good for another
The weather was very windy
Hotspur was sick from the cold
Bad luck always follows good luck
questions.evidence: it was an ill wind that blew nobody good

questions.q: How did Hotspur feel about being a cab-horse by the end of the week?
choices: An easy mouth and a free head made up for a great deal
He hated it more than ever
He wanted to go back to the nobleman
He refused to pull the cab
questions.evidence: an easy mouth and a free head made up for a great deal
